answer.answer: The Internship Programme of the Department of Expenditure is a Central Sector Scheme under the Ministry of Finance aimed at familiarizing eligible undergraduates pursuing five-year integrated courses and graduates pursuing post-graduation or research with the process of formulation of economic policies of the Government [E02]. The internship is neither a job nor any assurance for employment in the Department [E02]. It lasts from two to six months at different points during the financial year [E02]. Interns are attached to DS/Director level officers in different divisions based on their areas of interest [E02]. They receive token remuneration of ₹10,000 per month upon satisfactory completion and submission of their report/paper [E01], along with necessary logistics support including office space and computer with internet facilities [E02]. Upon completion, interns receive certificates and must provide feedback on their experience [E01].
